object:lump of royal jelly.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low pale golden mound of jelly with a soft highlight and tiny pink center fleck. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:lump of royal jelly.wikiDescription: Royal jelly is a NetHack comestible. Its source name supports a soft edible lump but not a container.
object:lump of royal jelly.modelBrief: Build a single squat glossy yellow-gold jelly mound with rounded edges and tiny pink glint. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: lump of royal jelly

object:cream pie.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a shallow tan pie dish topped by thick white cream with uneven pale peaks. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:cream pie.wikiDescription: A cream pie is an edible item that can also be thrown. The tile shows the whole pie with cream topping.
object:cream pie.modelBrief: Build a low round pastry shell filled with a raised mound of white cream. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:candy bar.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark brown rectangular bar with a lighter brown upper slab and blunt edges. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:candy bar.wikiDescription: A candy bar is an edible sweet in NetHack. No wrapper is visible in this PixelHack tile.
object:candy bar.modelBrief: Build a simple unwrapped rectangular brown candy bar with slightly uneven top face. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:fortune cookie.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a golden folded fortune cookie with a central crease, thick rim, and dark opening. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:fortune cookie.wikiDescription: A fortune cookie is an edible item that gives a fortune when eaten. The tile depicts the folded cookie, not a separate paper slip.
object:fortune cookie.modelBrief: Build one folded golden cookie with crescent-like split and dark inner crease. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:pancake.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a flat golden pancake with darker central mottling and a broad pale rim. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:pancake.wikiDescription: A pancake is a NetHack comestible. The wiki identity supports a cooked flat cake; toppings are not fixed.
object:pancake.modelBrief: Build one low round pancake with warm brown patches and no invented syrup bottle. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:lembas wafer.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick irregular tan wafer with brown crumbly patches and light lower edge. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:lembas wafer.wikiDescription: A lembas wafer is an edible Elven food in NetHack. PixelHack gives it a chunky bread-like form.
object:lembas wafer.modelBrief: Build one irregular pale-gold baked wafer with darker baked spots and low flat profile. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:cram ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows stacked small tan-and-pink ration portions beside a tall teal bottle-like form. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:cram ration.wikiDescription: A cram ration is a vegan comestible in NetHack. The bottle-like prop is an artwork detail rather than a stated ingredient.
object:cram ration.modelBrief: Build a compact ration arrangement of stacked rectangular portions and slim teal container, matching the sprite's proportions. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:food ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a large tan wrapped loaf or packet beside a tall teal bottle-like form. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:food ration.wikiDescription: A food ration is a basic vegan comestible in NetHack. Its exact packaging is supplied by PixelHack.
object:food ration.modelBrief: Build a bulky tan ration packet with brown upper fold and the narrow teal container behind it. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:K-ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a pale yellow rectangular ration carton with red cross-like mark and brown side panel. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:K-ration.wikiDescription: A K-ration is an edible ration in NetHack. The letter-like colored mark and box are sprite details.
object:K-ration.modelBrief: Build a squat pale ration box with a visible red mark and warm brown side face. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:C-ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a tan rectangular ration carton with a dark C-like mark and brown upper rim. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:C-ration.wikiDescription: A C-ration is an edible ration in NetHack. This tile uses a separate marked box from the K-ration.
object:C-ration.modelBrief: Build a tan ration carton with dark C-like front mark and restrained warm highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:tin.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark cylindrical metal tin with pale gray rolled rim and cool side reflection. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:tin.wikiDescription: A tin is metal-packaged preserved food in NetHack. Its contents vary, so this tile does not identify what is inside.
object:tin.modelBrief: Build a closed dark gray cylindrical can with pale crimped lid and simple reflective band. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:ruby / gain ability.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a bulb-bottom glass flask with a narrow neck, brown cork, dark rim, and a deep ruby-red pool with a bright orange-red center. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:ruby / gain ability.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes the potion of gain ability as a potion that can improve an attribute. The ruby liquid is this atlas slot's appearance; most potion appearances can shuffle between games.
object:ruby / gain ability.modelBrief: Use one shared narrow-neck clear bottle and brown cork, filling it with ruby-red liquid with a small warm central glint. Keep the visible liquid appearance separate from its possible game effect.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Potion of gain ability
